parameters.name: clientToken
parameters.description: A unique token generated by the client to guarantee the idempotency of the request. The maximum length is 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: modifyMode
parameters.description:
The modification mode. Valid values:

- Cover (default): overwrites the IP addresses in the original whitelist with the values specified in the ips parameter.

- Append: adds the IP addresses specified in the ips parameter to the original whitelist.

- Delete: removes the IP addresses specified in the ips parameter from the original whitelist. At least one IP address must be retained.
